about.heading: About Me

paragraphs.p1: As a fresh graduate focused on full-stack development with a backend emphasis, I turn complex ideas into functional, secure, and reliable applications using Laravel, REST APIs, MySQL, and React.
paragraphs.p2: My curiosity drives me to constantly experiment with new technologies, from designing robust APIs and managing data pipelines to building responsive interfaces with JavaScript and TypeScript.
paragraphs.p3: I see the backend as the core engine of an application. I am now looking for a full-time junior full-stack role with a backend focus where I can keep learning, build impactful systems, and grow with a team.

about.skillsIntro: I work across backend and frontend technologies to build maintainable end-to-end web applications and reliable backend services.
